## Rules

As in slice 1 (`docs/build/jobs/2026-10-23-slice-1.md`, "Rules"): PII baseline, fair-housing and never-scrape
rules, no owner name, the DEMONSTRATION mark, `git add <paths>` only for your files, commit at each working step
and push to `origin main`, `bash scripts/disk-check.sh` before installs and image builds. If the job stops for
budget, it is resumed with its context, so leave the tree committed and working at the last step and keep a short
"where I am" note in your last commit message.
